E0744

This package sets `policy.harden`, and its `timing: .Fixed` values would run on `{target}`, where no host is confirmed to run them in fixed time.

What

This package sets `policy.harden`, and its `timing: .Fixed` values would run on `{target}`, where no host is confirmed to run them in fixed time.

Why

WebAssembly leaves the machine instructions to the engine that compiles the module, and no engine states that its code takes the same time for every value; a hardened package refuses to start on an unconfirmed host, and on this target that is known when it is built.

Fix

Build for a native target, where the program checks its host when it starts, or remove `harden: true` from the package's `policy:`.
